content.name: Deniz Yılmaz
content.title: Backend Software Engineer
content.summary: Backend engineer with nine years in Kotlin and Java, starting as a Werkstudent during my master's and now building metering services for a Berlin energy-data company. Designed an event-sourced tariff engine that settles about 1.2 million customer accounts each month. Works comfortably across German- and English-speaking teams.

experience.title: Werkstudent Software Development
bullets: Built a Spring Boot service that pulled e-scooter battery telemetry every 30 seconds, giving the operations team a live map of 2,500 vehicles.
Implemented charging-route suggestions that reduced driving distance for the night shift by around 15%.
Worked 20 hours a week alongside my M.Sc., completing every sprint commitment over 20 months.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed warehouse slotting APIs in Kotlin used by 14 fulfilment centres, cutting average pick-path length by 11%.
Replaced a shared Oracle schema with per-service PostgreSQL databases, ending a weekly release freeze that blocked four teams.
Introduced contract tests with Pact between six services, catching breaking API changes before merge rather than in staging.
Onboarded three new engineers and wrote the team's German-English glossary of logistics terms.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
bullets: Designed an event-sourced tariff engine in Kotlin that settles around 1.2 million household accounts monthly, replacing a spreadsheet-driven process that took five days.
Implemented processing of smart-meter readings to market-communication formats, keeping data exchange with grid operators within regulatory deadlines.
Cut monthly cloud spend on the billing cluster by €6,500 by right-sizing Kubernetes workloads and moving cold data to object storage.
Own the team's on-call handbook and run blameless post-mortems after every customer-facing incident.

education.details: Thesis on consistency models for event-sourced systems. Grade 1.7.

courses.name: iSAQB Certified Professional for Software Architecture – Foundation Level

achievements.title: Maintainer of an open-source Kotlin event-store library
achievements.detail: Volunteer maintainer since 2021; reviewed contributions from about 30 developers.

achievements.title: Mentor, Berlin coding bootcamp for career changers
achievements.detail: Mentored five participants through their final projects; four now work as developers.
